entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire whose people live alongside dinosaurs that outsiders consider "domesticated."

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane beneath which lie the ruins of many ancient civilizations.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker quoted on the difference between running away and escaping fate.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: A speaker who warns that city people forget the wilderness has a head start.

entities.name: Fool's Fall
entities.description: A place whose headwaters are said to be home to strange serpents.

entities.name: Ertha Jo
entities.description: A frontier mentor who warns against going into the desert unprepared.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young man whose destiny is as uncertain as the land he gazes at.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The cosmic tree from which forgotten realms were violently cleaved.

entities.name: doomskars
entities.description: Cataclysms that shattered realms, as told in sagas.

entities.name: Drivnod
entities.description: A silent being who does unspeakable things and drifts over Ish Sah.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: A place over which Drivnod drifts.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A resistance spymaster who watches Drivnod in fear.

entities.name: Tinua
entities.description: A Skirsdag cultist who traded part of her soul to escape the abyss.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult to which Tinua belongs.

entities.name: Rho
entities.description: A veteran hero who speaks of defending neighbors.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: A land woven together by the magic of the land into a tapestry of friends.

entities.name: Fitzwhisker
entities.description: An otterfolk inventor who tried to build a frog diving suit.

entities.name: Benefactors
entities.description: A group that aids and protects survivors, marking safe zones with the sign of the flame.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A being once bound to a single house who expanded until it consumed the plane, feeding on cultists' fear.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: The house to which Valgavoth was bound and whose essence cultists are bound to.

entities.name: Rite of the Threshold
entities.description: A rite cultists undergo to let Valgavoth feed on their fear and bind them to the House.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker who delights that nothing he beats down stays down.

entities.name: Heroics: A Book of Fables
entities.description: A book of fables about fiends and champions.

entities.name: Sopia
entities.description: A Skelle cleric who freely trades away her breaths.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: An order to which the cleric Sopia belongs.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane with sky-scraping gardens tended by fashionable druids whose ancestors left a war-ravaged land.

entities.name: Ferren Gibrar
entities.description: An inventor whose award-winning invention from the Inventor's Fair became available to the public.

entities.name: Inventor's Fair
entities.description: A fair where Ferren Gibrar's invention won an award.

entities.name: Betor
entities.description: A voice of the untethered and lost ancestors and the memory of the Abzan, proud of Tarkir.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir whose memory Betor embodies.

entities.name: Teval
entities.description: A speaker who promises a fair and beautiful judgment.

entities.name: Ureni
entities.description: A speaker whose song is answered by the chorus of creation.

entities.name: Shiko
entities.description: A follower of the Way who seeks unity of mind to end strife on Tarkir.

entities.name: The Way
entities.description: A teaching urging striving toward unity of mind.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose people take pride in all it has endured.

entities.name: Neriv
entities.description: A speaker who believes strength comes from community.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The khan of the Mardu, who fought his first battle under Kolaghan and feels he has outgrown her.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragon under whom Zurgo fought his first battle.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir led by Zurgo.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A meditator who studied Ojutai's teachings and now considers his failings.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon whose teachings and failings Narset contemplates.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: A being who sheds a single wish with every morningtide.

entities.name: thoughtweft
entities.description: A force that guides a fighter's hands with the will of an entire clachan.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A fae ascendant who speaks of painful sacrifice and beautiful outcomes.

entities.name: Rotscab
entities.description: A goblin whose ridiculous look made his warren-mates envious.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A land whose boggarts fondly remember their kills.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A figure some believed to be the source of the world's magic.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who compleated beings during the Invasion.

entities.name: The Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion, during which some things were judged not worth compleating.

events.summary: Valgavoth, once bound to a single house, expanded its boundaries until it consumed the plane and turned it into his playground of terror.
events.quote: Bound to a single house, Valgavoth simply expanded its boundaries until it consumed the plane, turning a vibrant world into his playground of terror.

events.summary: Tinua recalls paying a price to an unnamed being, a bit of her soul, to escape the abyss.
events.quote: I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss.

events.summary: Ferren Gibrar's invention won an award at the Inventor's Fair and became available to the public.
events.quote: Ferren Gibrar's award-winning invention from the Inventor's Fair-now available to the general public.

events.summary: Zurgo remembers fighting his first battle under Kolaghan and says he has outgrown her.
events.quote: This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan. How I have outgrown her.

events.summary: Narset, who once meditated on Ojutai's teachings, now must also consider his failings.
events.quote: Now, I must also consider his failings.

relations.note: Formerly fought under Kolaghan; feels he has outgrown her.
relations.quote: This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan.
I came here often to meditate on Ojutai's teachings.

relations.note: Betor speaks as the memory of the Abzan.

relations.quote: As he drifts over Ish Sah, a deathly whisper rides the wind.

relations.note: Was bound to the House and binds cultists to its essence.
relations.quote: allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.
